# Strings, operators, pipes and every pure built-in function evaluate as
# documented. The command writes each result to a file to compare.
env LANG_TEST_VAR=set
bit
cmp out.txt want.txt

-- BUILD.bit --
let name = "world"
let items = ["a", "b"] + ["b", "c"]
let raw = 'no #{name} \n here'
let escaped = "\#{name}"
let indented = <<-EOF
  hello #{name | trim}
    nested
  EOF
let verbatim = <<EOF
  keep
EOF
let cond = if name == "world" then "yes" else "no"
let neq = if name != "world" then "yes" else "no"

out = exec {
  command = <<-EOF
    {
      echo "concat=#{"a" + "b"} #{uniq(items) | shell_join}"
      echo 'raw=#{raw}'
      echo "indented=#{indented}"
      echo "verbatim=#{verbatim}"
      echo "escape=#{escaped}"
      echo "cond=#{cond} #{neq}"
      echo "env=#{env("LANG_TEST_VAR", "fallback")} #{env("LANG_UNSET_VAR", "fallback")}"
      echo "exec=#{exec("echo  hi ") | trim}"
      echo "glob=#{glob("src/*.txt") | shell_join}"
      echo "lines=#{lines("a\n\nb\n") | shell_join}"
      echo "split=#{split("a,b,c", ",") | shell_join}"
      echo "trim=#{trim(["  x ", "y  "]) | shell_join}"
      echo "trim_prefix=#{trim_prefix("libfoo.a", "lib")} #{trim_prefix("foo", "lib")}"
      echo "trim_suffix=#{trim_suffix(["a.go", "b.rs"], ".go") | shell_join}"
      echo "prefix=#{prefix(["a", "b"], "-") | shell_join}"
      echo "suffix=#{suffix("x", ".txt")}"
      echo "basename=#{basename("/a/b/c.txt")}"
      echo "dirname=#{dirname(["/a/b/c.txt", "d/e"]) | shell_join}"
      echo "replace=#{replace("v1.2.3", "v(\\d+)\\..*", "major $1")}"
      echo "filter=#{filter(["a.go", "b_test.go", "c.go"], "_test\\.go$") | shell_join}"
      echo "sha256=#{sha256("abc")}"
      echo "shell_join=#{shell_join(["a b", "c"])}"
      echo "shell_split=#{shell_split("x 'y z'") | prefix("<") | suffix(">") | shell_join}"
      echo "project_dir=#{project_dir() | basename}"
      echo "pipe=#{"  a,b " | trim | split(",") | suffix("!") | shell_join}"
    } > out.txt
  EOF
  outputs = "out.txt"
}
-- src/one.txt --
1
-- src/two.txt --
2
-- want.txt --
concat=ab a b c
raw=no #{name} \n here
indented=hello world
  nested
verbatim=  keep
escape=#{name}
cond=yes no
env=set fallback
exec=hi
glob=src/one.txt src/two.txt
lines=a b
split=a b c
trim=x y
trim_prefix=foo.a foo
trim_suffix=a b.rs
prefix=-a -b
suffix=x.txt
basename=c.txt
dirname=/a/b d
replace=major 1
filter=b_test.go
sha256=ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad
shell_join='a b' c
shell_split='<x>' '<y z>'
project_dir=work
pipe='a!' 'b!'
